kb-core-ui's vector memory holds non-code knowledge — primary codebase
rules, lessons learned, business-logic/data-dependency notes, and what the
software does — as embeddings you can search semantically. It's the
counterpart to the code graph: the graph answers "where does this code
live", memory answers "what do we know that isn't in the code". Kept in
<repo>/.kb-core-ui/memory.db, separate from the graph so re-indexing never
wipes it.

Usage:
  kb-core-ui memory [command]

Available Commands:
  add         Add a memory entry
  list        List memory entries (newest first)
  rm          Remove a memory entry by id
  search      Semantically search memory for the entries most relevant to a query

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for memory

Use "kb-core-ui memory [command] --help" for more information about a command.
